## Good First Issue

Difficulty: Beginner
Estimated time:

## Task

Describe one concrete change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The requested change is implemented.
- [ ] The Pull Request stays focused.
- [ ] Relevant validation passes.

## Contribution steps

1. Star our repo.
2. Fork the repository.
3. Comment if you want to work on this issue.
4. Create a focused branch.
5. Make the change.
6. Run relevant validation.
7. Open a Pull Request.
8. Add Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER to the Pull Request description.

See BEGINNER_CONTRIBUTING.md for the full walkthrough.
